text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> and I are out
shopping for
shoes when we run into
Trainer Kiryuin and Happy
Meek.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't
Trainer
<username>!
Are
you buying shoes as well?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Of course! After all, a first-rate
Umamusume
needs first-rate gear!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I start looking through the shelves
alongside an
excited Trainer Kiryuin.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Look, Meek! It's those new shoes from
the
magazine.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Their performance is backed up by
sports science
and endorsed by
top-level Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But from a comfort perspective, the
shoes next to
them are the way to go.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
This model has excellent cushioning and
reduces
strain on the legs.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Considering your running style, these
may be the
better choice.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Right...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Happy Meek nods. She opens her mouth
as if to
speak, but closes it again without
saying
anything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I realize she's staring at something and
follow her
gaze to another pair of shoes.
If my hunch is
correct...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Right, I've made up my mind!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Could you wait here, Meek? I'm just
going to go
pay.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: All right...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
No... It's all right. I'm happy with the
shoes my
trainer picked out for me.
choice_data_list: あの靴がいいって言わなくていいのか？
あの靴がいいって言わなくていいの？
choice_data_list_en: Are you sure you don't want to tell them you like those shoes?
Are you sure you don't want to tell them you like those shoes?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
I know she's just thinking about what's
best for
me... She works really hard, you
know.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
So it's fine... I just thought those shoes
looked
like baguettes, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: You... really think so?
choice_data_list: 素直な気持ちを伝えた方が喜ばれるぞ
素直な気持ちを伝えた方が喜ばれるよ
choice_data_list_en: They'll appreciate it more if you tell them how you really feel.
She'll appreciate it more if you tell her how you really feel.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Thank you... I'll go and tell her...
choice_data_list: 俺もトレーナーだから、わかる
私もトレーナーだから、わかる
choice_data_list_en: I'm a Trainer too, so I understand.
I understand, because I'm a Trainer too.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Meek...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I got so caught up in doing what I
thought was
best, I didn't think to
consider you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: What's most important is that the shoes fit your desires. Asking you how you felt should have been the first thing I did.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Let's go back to the store and choose again, shall we? This time, together.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for looking out for Meek,

Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: I also want to say... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
From now on... I'll tell my trainer what I
want when
we're choosing shoes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After seeing off Trainer Kiryuin,

<chrname> and I pick out a
pair of
shoes that fit her preferences.
